key.description: Full key, returned only once at creation or rotation

online.description: Heartbeat received within the last 2 minutes

token.description: Agent token, returned only at registration

password.description: Optional initial password (must be changed at first login). Without it an invitation e-mail is sent.

delegatorUserId.description: Defaults to the current user; others require platform.approval.delegate

deviceToken.description: Enrollment token, returned only once at registration or rotation

verificationRecordName.description: DNS TXT record name to create

csv.description: CSV content with a header row (JSON field names or labels)

credentialKeys.description: Names of credentials that are set; values are never returned

comingSoon.description: Module is enabled but its features arrive in a later phase

masked.description: Personal data masked because the viewer lacks audit.log.view_sensitive

qrCodePng.description: data: URL of a QR code image

permissions.description: Permissions at the active property (X-Property-Id) or across all properties

shells.description: Application surfaces this user may open

inEffect.description: This version is the one currently in force

effectiveFrom.description: Default now; cannot be in the past once a version exists
Defaults to now; must not be in the past once a version exists

amount.description: Decimal amount used by workflow conditions

credentials.description: Keys present replace stored values; empty string removes a key

apiKey.description: Server-to-server API key with limited scopes (FR-INT-06).

info.description: OneClub P0 Platform Foundation API. Conventions: /api/v1/<module>/<resource>, camelCase JSON, cursor pagination (?cursor=&limit=), filters (?filter[field]=), RFC 9457 Problem Details, Idempotency-Key, X-Property-Id for property-scoped resources.
